queries: WITH invoice_counts AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count FROM Orders AS o LEFT JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), shares AS (SELECT invoice_count, invoice_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(invoice_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM invoice_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.invoice_count), 0) AS total_invoices, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.value) AS average_excess_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.value;

WITH invoice_counts AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count FROM Orders AS o LEFT JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), shares AS (SELECT invoice_count, 1.0 * invoice_count / NULLIF(SUM(invoice_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM invoice_counts), scored AS (SELECT invoice_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(invoice_count), 0) AS total_number_of_invoices, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - overall_average_share) AS average_excess FROM scored WHERE share > overall_average_share;

WITH order_counts AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count FROM Orders AS o LEFT JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), shares AS (SELECT order_id, invoice_count, 1.0 * invoice_count / NULLIF(SUM(invoice_count) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM order_counts), compared AS (SELECT invoice_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE share > average_share HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
